_source.jobDescription: Job Scope &Responsibilities - Revenue Manager Usagi SG Pte Ltd operates Cafe Usagi Tokyo and Shake Shake In A Tub across its Singapore outlets, and supplies ceremonial and culinary grade matcha to trade customers through its Matcha Distribution Division. The business is moving from a single-format cafe operator into a multi- channel group carrying dine-in, delivery aggregator, direct e-commerce, wholesale and franchise revenue streams, each with a different cost structure and margin profile. Your key responsibilities include, but are not limited to, the following: 3.1 Revenue Performance Analysis and Reporting . Consolidate daily and weekly sales data from the point-of-sale, the GrabFood, Foodpanda and Shopee Foodmerchant dashboards and the online store into a single revenue view by outlet, channel and product category. . Analyse revenue mix and contribution margin by channel, isolating the effect of delivery aggregator commission on net revenue per order. . Build and maintain a monthly revenue dashboard reporting average transaction value, transaction count, basket composition, channel mix and gross margin by outlet, presented to the General Manager. . Track theMatcha Distribution Division as a separate revenue line, reporting wholesale volume, average selling price per kilogramme and customer concentration by trade account. . Identify revenue leakage from discounting, voided transactions, aggregator promotional funding and under-priced items, and quantify the value recovered each month. 3.2 Strategic Pricing and Menu Engineering . Establish a price architecture across dine-in, takeaway, delivery aggregator, direct e-commerce and wholesale, setting channel-specific pricing that absorbs commission and packaging cost without eroding gross margin. . Conduct menu engineering on the Cafe Usagi Tokyo and Shake Shake In A Tub menus, classifying each item by contribution margin and sales volume, and recommending retention,re-pricing, re-engineering or delisting. . Calculate and maintain recipe-level food cost and theoretical gross margin for all beverage and food items, updating on ingredient price movement, in particular on imported Japanese matcha. . Formulate wholesale and trade pricing tiers for the Matcha Distribution Division based on order volume, payment terms and account type. . Design and evaluate promotional and bundle pricing across dine-in, aggregator and e-commerce channels, measuring incremental revenue and margin effect against a control period rather than headline sales uplift. 3.3 Demand Forecasting and Product Development Insight . Analyse historical transaction data to forecast demand by outlet, daypart, day of week and season, and translate the forecast into production and procurement volumes. . Apply AI-enabled analysis tools to identify demand patterns, basket affinities and emerging product trends across the customer base. . Produce a quarterly demand and trend report informing new menu development, specifying which categories to expand, hold or retire, with a projected margin contribution for each recommendation. . Model the revenue and margin case for new product launches and limited-time offers before commitment, including breakeven volume and cannibalisation risk. . Assess demand signals from the wholesale and franchise pipeline to inform matcha inventory planning and supplier commitments. 3.4 Revenue Optimisation across Channels and Formats . Optimise channel mix by shifting volume toward higher-margin direct channels, setting ameasurable target for direct e-commerce and dine-in share of total revenue. . Manage capacity and yield at outlet level, using daypart pricing, menu availability and throughput analysis to raise revenue per available seat hour and revenue per labour hour. . Review and renegotiate delivery aggregator commercial terms, commission rates and promotional co-funding on a recurring cycle. . Improve commercial productivity by standardising pricing, ordering and reporting workflows across outlets, reducing manual consolidation time and eliminating duplicate data entry. . Develop the revenue case for new outlets, formats and franchise territories, including projected sales, cost structure, breakeven timeline and payback period. . Track performance against budget monthly, explaining variance by channel and outlet, and recommending corrective pricing or mix action. 3.5 Sustainability, Food Waste Reduction and Margin Protection . Establish food waste tracking at outlet and central production level, measuring waste bycategory and value, and set a reduction target against a documented baseline. . Analyse yield and wastage on high-value ingredients, in particular matcha, dairy and fresh produce, and implement portioning, batching and shelf-life controls that convert waste reduction into recovered gross margin. . Implement demand-led production and ordering practices that reduce over-production and end-of- day disposal, coordinating par levels with outlet and kitchen teams. . Evaluate packaging and delivery packaging materials for cost, environmental impact and suitability, and recommend transitions to lower-impact options where unit cost and customer experience allow. . Assess supplier and procurement practices against environmental sustainability criteria, including sourcing provenance, transport footprint and supplier certification, and report the commercial and environmental effect of any switch. . Report quarterly on sustainability performance, expressing waste reduction, packaging and sourcing outcomes in both environmental and financial terms for the General Manager. 3.6 Commercial Compliance, Franchise and Wholesale Agreements . Prepare and maintain commercial terms for franchise agreements, including fee structure, royalty rate, territory definition and minimum performance obligations. . Verify that pricing, product labelling and promotional claims comply with Singapore Food Agency licensing and labelling requirements, and with the corresponding requirements in each franchise market. . Maintain trade and wholesale agreements for the Matcha Distribution Division, covering credit terms, minimum order quantities, pricing validity and delivery obligations. . Review supplier and aggregator contracts for commercial risk, renewal dates and rate change clauses, and maintain a contract register with review dates. . Coordinate with external advisers on intellectual property, trade mark and franchise documentation for overseas market entry. 3.7 Cross-Functional Coordination and Ad Hoc Duties . Work with outlet and kitchen teams to implement pricing, menu and portioning changes, and confirm accurate execution at the point of sale. . Support the General Manager on commercial submissions, partner materials and business planning.

_source.jobDescription: Organisation Overview GWS Living Art is a pioneer in sustainable urban greenery, creating vibrant, nature-integrated solutions for cities across Asia. From vertical gardens and green roofs to innovative water-sensitive urban designs, our projects blend engineering, ecology, and art to bring nature back into the built environment. As we continue to grow, maintaining a safe and compliant work environment across our project sites is fundamental to our mission. Brief Description We are seeking a proactive and competent Safety Coordinator to strengthen workplace safety across our green infrastructure projects. This role involves conducting site inspections, ensuring regulatory compliance, developing safety documentation, and supporting our teams in maintaining high WSH standards. The ideal candidate is hands-on, organised, and comfortable working across diverse project environments - from rooftop gardens to construction sites and green façades. Job Description Workplace Safety Management Ensure all project sites comply with MOM, WSH Act, and relevant codes of practice. Maintain and update Risk Assessments (RA), Safe Work Procedures (SWP), and Method Statements. Ensure proper issuance and compliance of Permit-to-Work (PTW) systems. Support the development and implementation of company-wide safety policies and procedures. Site Safety Coordination Conduct routine safety inspections across sites (e.g., green walls, rooftop gardens, water systems, construction works). Identify hazards, follow up on corrective actions, and ensure closure of non-compliance items. Verify safe use of PPE, tools, lifting equipment, and work-at-height systems. Coordinate with Project, Operations, and Maintenance teams to ensure safe site execution. Training & Safety Culture Development Conduct toolbox meetings, safety briefings, and emergency response training. Track and update worker training records (WAH, MEWP, CSOC, etc.). Promote and embed a strong safety culture among workers, subcontractors, and partners. Incident Response & Documentation Assist in investigations of incidents, near-misses, and unsafe acts. Prepare incident reports and recommend preventive measures. Maintain full documentation for audits, inspections, and internal reporting. Support external audits (ISO, client safety audits, main-con safety requirements). Job Requirements Qualifications WSQ Advanced Certificate in Workplace Safety and Health (Level B) or equivalent. Additional certifications (e.g., Work-at-Height Assessor, MEWP) are an advantage. Experience 1-3 years of relevant experience in construction, landscaping, façade works, facilities management, or similar sectors. Prior experience supporting rooftop or work-at-height environments is highly preferred. Skills & Attributes Strong understanding of Singapore's WSH regulations and PTW systems. Good communication skills with the ability to engage workers and subcontractors. Detail-oriented and proactive, with good investigative and follow-up skills. Comfortable with both field work and administrative/documentation tasks. Physically able to perform site inspections in outdoor and elevated environments. Why Join Us At GWS Living Art, you will play a vital role in ensuring the safe delivery of meaningful, sustainable projects that reshape urban environments. You'll work closely with a passionate team committed to innovation, quality, and safety. Your contributions will directly support the creation of greener, healthier cities.

_source.jobDescription: About the Role We are looking for a Quality Lab Assistant Manager to oversee laboratory operations and lead a team of Lab Analysts and Controllers in supporting quality control and manufacturing activities. The role will ensure laboratory practices comply with applicable quality and regulatory standards while driving operational efficiency and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities Lead, supervise, and coach Lab Analysts, Technicians, Chemists, and Microbiologists in analytical testing activities. Ensure laboratory testing, data review, and analysis are performed safely, accurately, and reliably in accordance with established procedures. Ensure laboratory operations comply with EN ISO 13485, cGMP, JQMS, and Good Documentation Practices (GDP) . Oversee daily laboratory operations, troubleshooting, investigations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Supervise laboratory testing activities, including equipment troubleshooting, equipment failures, and investigations. Review analytical test results for raw materials and finished products and monitor trends to identify potential anomalies and prevent out-of-specification (OOS) situations. Conduct root cause analysis and implement appropriate corrective actions during laboratory investigations. Ensure corrective and preventive actions are completed within the required timelines. Make scientifically sound and risk-based decisions when handling laboratory issues and investigations. Monitor laboratory inventory to ensure adequate availability of consumables, chemicals, and supplies. Plan and schedule laboratory manpower to ensure smooth daily operations. Establish, review, and approve laboratory operating procedures where required. Train laboratory personnel on SOPs, equipment operation, test methods, and laboratory controls. _source.jobDescription: Work Your Magic with us! Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more We know you've got big plans - so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people's lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us. Your Role: Reporting into the Lab Manager or Manager-Biosafety Testing, the Associate Scientist III - Biosafety Testing is responsible to perform a wide variety of routine tasks to support GMP operations and primarily focusses on Molecular Biology, NGS and BLAZAR work related to Biosafety Testing. Responsibilities include performing Biosafety assays in both Molecular Biology laboratories which required to characterize product, preparing and qualifying of reagents, monitoring stock levels, and conducting general equipment maintenance to sustain seamless workflow and optimal performance of laboratory equipment. The Associate Scientist III may require to provide training and / or mentoring junior members of lab personnel. The ability to maintain effective working relationships with Scientists, Lab Scientists, support services, and laboratory personnel will be critical for success in this role. What You Do: Works within the Molecular Biology and NGS laboratories following Standard Operating Procedures and compliance regulations. Adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Compliance Regulations: Ensure all work is carried out according to established protocols and regulatory standards. Learning Management System: Ensure zero overdue LMS records, timely complete training required to perform the assay or task. Timely Completion of Studies and Record Keeping: Complete routine and custom studies on time, maintaining accurate records that meet scientific and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. Assay Validations: Perform validations of assays following relevant protocols. Document Control: Maintain SOPs, laboratory books, and forms, ensuring outdated versions are removed promptly. Review and improve working documents through document control processes. Stock Control and Procurement: Manage stock levels, order consumables, and handle procurement through designated systems. Laboratory Maintenance: Conduct housekeeping, equipment checks, and environmental and personnel monitoring to ensure compliance and safety. Health and Safety: Maintain a clean, tidy, and safe work environment, adhering to health and safety policies and procedures. Training and Mentoring: May require to train and mentor newer or junior members of the lab personnel. Quality Audits and Regulatory Compliance: Participate in internal quality audits and regulatory audits as required. Audit Readiness: Maintain a constant state of readiness for audits across all laboratory areas. Protocol and SOP Development: Author laboratory protocols, SOPs, and workbooks for projects. Peer Review and Data Management: Conduct peer reviews of raw data records and ensure accurate data management practices on a timely mannner. Deviation/Discrepancies: Raise and progress deviation and Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) records promptly. Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify and implement improvements to laboratory processes and procedures to enhance efficiency and reduce waste. Site or Global Initiatives: participate in site or global initiatives Who You Are: Minimum Degree in Biological Sciences or higher qualification in relevant scientific subject 3 plus years of working experience in biologics or biopharmaceutical industry 3 plus years of working experience in a regulated environment (GMP or equivalent) 2 plus years of working experience in specific area of expertise (molecular biology, virology, microbiology/mycoplasma) with demonstrated ability to trouble-shoot Quality mindset and good understanding of GMP Demonstratable experience in implementing projects to set-up/improve lab processes/systems Good oral and written communication skills in English Capability on problem solving and planning skills ERP experience is an asset (Oracle / SAP/ LIMS/ Trackwise) Proficient in Microsoft programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc) Adheres to safety SOPs and follows safe work practices Always ensures a safe and healthy work environment Team player, proactive and willing to take ownership

_source.jobDescription: Job Description & Requirements Sommelier - Restaurant Zén, Singapore Join one of the world's most acclaimed fine dining destinations and be part of an exceptional wine program at Restaurant Zén, Singapore's Three Michelin Star restaurant under the globally celebrated Frantzén Group. Housed within a beautifully restored heritage shophouse in the heart of Singapore, Zén offers a multi-level dining experience combining Nordic craftsmanship with Asian flavours. As a Sommelier, you will play an important role in delivering an exceptional beverage experience, from thoughtful wine recommendations and pairings to impeccable wine service. About the Role As part of the sommelier team, you will work closely with the Beverage Director, Head Sommelier, chefs, and service team to ensure that every wine experience complements our tasting menu and meets Zén's exacting standards. You will be responsible for providing knowledgeable and attentive wine service, engaging guests through thoughtful recommendations, and continuously developing your knowledge of wine and beverage. What We're Looking For Wine Knowledge & Qualifications WSET Level 2 or CMS Introductory Sommelier certification required. Good understanding of major wine regions, grape varieties, wine styles, and basic wine production. Strong interest in wine and a genuine desire to continuously develop your knowledge and palate. Previous experience in fine dining, luxury hospitality, or a professional wine environment is preferred. Wine Service Able to perform professional wine service with confidence, precision, and attention to detail. Comfortable recommending wines and explaining their characteristics in an engaging and approachable manner. Demonstrates good understanding of food and wine pairing principles. Maintains high standards of cellar organisation, wine storage, and service equipment. Guest Experience Warm, polished, and confident when interacting with guests. Able to communicate wine knowledge clearly without being overly technical. Attentive to individual guest preferences and able to make suitable recommendations. Comfortable serving VIP and discerning guests with professionalism and discretion. Teamwork & Professionalism Works effectively with the sommelier and service teams to maintain consistent service standards. Willing to learn from senior team members and share knowledge with colleagues. Demonstrates a positive attitude, strong work ethic, and attention to detail. Able to work effectively in a fast-paced, high-standard fine dining environment. Key Responsibilities Provide professional and attentive wine service throughout the guest experience. Recommend wines and beverage pairings based on guest preferences and the tasting menu. Present and explain wines confidently, including producers, regions, vintages, and styles where appropriate. Assist with the execution of wine pairings and beverage service. Maintain the organisation, cleanliness, and condition of the wine cellar and service areas. Assist with receiving, checking, storing, and rotating wine inventory. Support regular stock counts and inventory management. Assist with wine list maintenance and updates under the guidance of the Head Sommelier and Beverage Director. Participate in wine tastings, training sessions, and supplier presentations to continuously develop product knowledge. Maintain high standards of wine service, hygiene, safety, and compliance. Work closely with the kitchen and service teams to deliver a seamless overall dining experience. Contribute to a culture of learning, professionalism, and continuous improvement within the restaurant. Why Join Zén At Zén, you will have the opportunity to work alongside an experienced beverage and service team in one of Singapore's most acclaimed fine dining restaurants. You will be exposed to an exceptional wine program, a world-class tasting menu, and a culture that places strong emphasis on knowledge, craftsmanship, and hospitality. This is an excellent opportunity for a passionate wine professional looking to further develop their sommelier skills and build a career within an internationally recognised fine dining environment.

_source.jobDescription: Turn our global manufacturing network into a competitive advantage. Match the right suppliers to the right parts and make them better. Join our global team for a career filled with opportunities to solve challenges both small and large, local and global, simple and complex. Join Pelagus as a Manufacturing & Supply Chain Engineer (1 Year Contract) and help shape the future of on-demand manufacturing! Who We Are Pelagus is the trusted on-demand manufacturing partner for OEMs in the maritime and energy industries. Backed by ThyssenKrupp and Wilhelmsen, Pelagus helps OEMs digitalize their spare parts portfolios, starting with legacy parts where availability is most critical, and deliver them on demand to customers worldwide. Through our secure digital inventory and global network of qualified manufacturers, Pelagus is reducing lead times, eliminating supply chain bottlenecks, and ensuring that parts are readily available to the highest quality standards. With current partnerships with leading OEMs and major end users globally, Pelagus is driving the industry shift toward digital spare parts and on-demand manufacturing. Your Role Our manufacturing network is the engine of Pelagus. As a Manufacturing & Supply Chain Engineer you will help build and strengthen that network, and make sure every project is matched to the right supplier with the right capabilities, quality and cost. You will sit at the intersection of engineering, supply chain and operations, running RFQs and negotiations, driving Design for Manufacturing, and turning supplier performance data into continuous improvement. It is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone who wants to see their decisions impact critical parts in high value industries. What You'll Do Support the Manufacturing & Supply Chain Managers in developing and expanding Pelagus global manufacturing network, identifying, onboarding and qualifying new suppliers to close capability, capacity and geographical gaps. Match projects and parts to the most suitable suppliers, balancing technical capability, quality, cost, capacity and lead time to ensure the right fit for every job. Run the RFQ process end-to-end: prepare technical enquiry packages, obtain and evaluate quotations, and lead commercial negotiations to secure the best value. Drive Design for Manufacturing (DfM) reviews with suppliers and internal engineering teams to optimise parts for cost, quality and manufacturability. Support day-to-day manufacturing operations, working with suppliers to ensure the timely, in-specification delivery of parts and resolving production issues as they arise. Track supplier performance against clear metrics (quality, on-time delivery, cost, responsiveness) and drive improvement plans and corrective actions. Collaborate with cross-functional international teams across engineering, quality, commercial and operations, and with suppliers and partners around the world. Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations, particularly related to the Maritime and Oil & Gas sectors. Contribute to building the tools, data and processes that make supplier selection and performance management scalable as the network and commercial opportunities grow. What You'll Bring Enthusiasm, curiosity, and a genuine passion for innovation and advanced technology. A bachelor's degree in mechanical, Manufacturing or Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related technical field (or equivalent experience). Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, procurement or supplier engineering, ideally in an engineering or industrial environment. Solid understanding of manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, casting, fabrication, industrial additive manufacturing / 3D printing) and Design for Manufacturing principles. Experience running RFQs, evaluating quotations and negotiating with suppliers, with a commercial, value-oriented mindset. Experience in tracking supplier or vendor performance and driving measurable Improvement through data and corrective actions is a bonus. Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional international teams and external partners. Strong analytical skills and confidence working with digital tools. Digital inventory or supply chain management system familiarization is highly regarded. Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously, ensuring deadlines are met and requirements are exceeded. Knowledge of quality management systems, and of the Maritime, Oil & Gas or additive / on-demand manufacturing sectors, is a strong bonus

_source.jobDescription: Our globally distributed cyber data engineering squad is responsible for designing, engineering, and maintaining large-scale security analytics platforms using Splunk, Elasticsearch, and associated data pipeline technologies. These platforms underpin critical cyber capabilities across security response, threat hunting, investigations, insider threat, and wider technology risk functions. We are seeking a Cyber Data Engineer to strengthen APAC cyber engineering coverage from Singapore, with a focus on hands-on platform engineering, automation, data onboarding, troubleshooting, and operational resilience. The successful candidate will work on complex cyber data platforms that ingest, transform, store, and expose security event data for detection, investigation, and response use cases. Role Profile: Engineering and maintaining large-scale cyber analytics platforms, including Splunk, Elasticsearch, and associated data ingestion and storage components. Onboarding new cyber data sources, validating event quality, developing field extractions, and ensuring data is usable for detection, investigation, and response teams. Designing, building, and supporting data pipelines that collect, transform, route, and transmit cyber event data from cloud and on-premises sources. Developing automation tools that integrate with internal APIs, configuration management frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure services. Improving platform reliability, scalability, monitoring, alerting, recovery, and operational resilience across APAC and global cyber engineering environments. Investigating and resolving complex technical issues across application, infrastructure, network, operating system, data, and integration layers. Acting as an escalation point for difficult platform, ingestion, search, performance, and data availability issues. Identifying and implementing tuning opportunities to improve platform performance, reduce operational toil, and increase engineering efficiency. Partnering with cyber stakeholders across threat hunting, detection engineering, incident response, investigations, insider threat, and technology risk to deliver fit-for-purpose engineering solutions. Candidate Profile: The ideal candidate is a hands-on cyber engineer who enjoys solving complex technical problems across data, platforms, infrastructure, and automation. They should be comfortable working across coding, troubleshooting, and stakeholder engagement. The candidate should be able to operate independently, learn quickly, and maintain reliable cyber platforms at scale in a fast-moving environment. _source.jobTitle: Primary Science Teacher | Semi-flexi WFH | Full-time, Permanent
_source.organizationName: MONSTER INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED (On behalf of Confidential)
_source.jobDescription: Are you a passionate graduate in search of a teaching career that supports your learning and growth, compensates well, while making a meaningful impact together with a team [About Our Team] At The Pique Lab, we're on a mission to create the best Science learning experience for students aged 9 to 16 in Singapore. Our lessons are meticulously crafted based on pedagogical research, data-driven methodologies and have one overarching goal: to make learning fun, shorten learning curves and help students develop a genuine appreciation for Science. Over the past decade, we've grown from a pair of co-founders to a diverse team of over 80 team members across 10 departments. Our proprietary learning methodology and examination-centric materials have helped more than 20,000 students ace their Science examinations. Our headquarters is in Singapore, with additional offices in China, Philippines and Malaysia. We take pride in our open, fast-paced and flat organisational structure where every team member is valued for their skills and competencies, not just their job titles. We are looking for passionate Science lovers to join us to bring the joy of learning to more children. Who knows You might be nurturing the next Albert Einstein or Marie Curie! If you like the prospects of working in a close-knit team, leveraging tech to work hyper-efficiently while tackling challenges head-on, we'd love to talk to you about joining the team! [Your Role] As a Primary Science Teacher at The Pique Lab, you will be involved in: Class & Learning Management - You will manage classes (online & onsite) effectively with a holistic understanding of your students learning needs and motivations Lesson Preparation & Delivery - You'll prepare for your lessons in accordance to our curriculum. In particular, you'll devise ways to simplify Science concepts and highlight common misconceptions. Publishing - You'll share your knowledge by writing articles and producing videos, so that your students can continue to learn from you outside of the classroom. Communication - You'll communicate with parents on their children's learning progress and make appropriate recommendations on how to improve further. [Your Growth] Your success as a Primary Science Tutor means a lot to us. Rigorous training is provided during your first 9 months at The Pique Lab, which is aimed at increasing your confidence and expertise as a Primary Science Teacher. You will start your career with us by undergoing the Teaching Associate Programme where you'll learn plenty of valuable teaching skills: Content Mastery: Solidify your fundamentals in the Primary Science syllabus by learning key concepts & examination question types. Understand how to apply a variety of answering techniques to tackle questions effectively. Attention Control: Discover how to make your lessons come alive, such that your students never get bored of them. Dive deep into delivery technicals such as coherency, clarity, tempo, gestures, expression and humour. Class Control : Pick up effective classroom management strategies, so that you're able to maintain a fun, yet disciplined teaching approach with your students. Performance Management : Learn how to use cues effectively to instil a stronger sense of confidence in your students & help them develop a stronger affinity for Science. Communicating With Parents : Understand how to communicate with parents, such that they are supportive and appreciative of your work. After you've achieved mastery in your fundamentals, you can look forward to explore various career pathways (Specialist Track & Management Track) where we'll work closely with you to spearhead projects or manage teams. [You, Our Ideal Candidate] We'd love to have a chat with you if you meet the following criteria: Required: Strong Background in Science : You should have a strong understanding in the subject matter - not just at the university level, but at a primary/secondary level, and hence be able to simplify complex Science concepts. Prior Teaching Experience : You should have some experience in teaching, not strictly limited to Science - be it commercial experience (e.g. teaching in MOE schools, tuition centres or private 1-1 classes) OR volunteering experience (e.g. coaching kids in after-school care centres). Good to have: A Positive, Confident & Engaging Personality : You need to be comfortable engaging students at a group level & infuse joy and laughter in your lessons. Grit and Drive to Succeed : You must be committed to mastery and be willing to put in the hard work. You should have a clear idea on what you intend to pursue in your career, at least for the next 3 to 5 years, Ability to learn fast and think on your feet : You will be expected to pick up and apply strategies and techniques taught to you quickly, especially during the training period. [Your Welfare] [Biggest Takeaway] Mentorship, Training & Regular Feedback Abundant Career Progression Opportunities in two different tracks: Specialist track and Management track Competitive Remuneration, including a base salary (starting from $3,400/ month) plus a variable pay (which scales based on your contributions) Annual Performance Bonus Medical, Dental & Vision Benefits Technology Benefits Paid Leaves Time-off From Work For Errands Fully-stocked Pantry Free Meals on selected school holidays and weekends Company Socials Work From Home Care Packages [Take Note ] We respect your time commitment with us. As such, you'll be paid full salary , even during your training period. There are no part-time teaching positions due to the amount of resources required to groom teachers to excellence. We specialise only in Primary Science and will continue to deepen our expertise in this area within the next 3 to 5 years . If you're only keen to teach Mathematics or English, we're probably not a good fit for you.

Job Description The National University of Singapore invites applications for a Research Assistant/Associate position in the Department of Biochemistry, Yong Loo Lin School of Medicine. Our laboratory conducts interdisciplinary research at the interface of human genetics, functional genomics, molecular biology and cardiometabolic disease, with a particular interest in understanding the molecular mechanisms underlying obesity, dyslipidaemia, atherosclerosis and related metabolic disorders. We combine genetic and multi-omics approaches with cellular and animal models and high-throughput functional studies to identify and validate disease-relevant pathways and therapeutic targets. The successful candidate will join a dynamic research team and play a key role in supporting the day-to-day operation of the laboratory while also contributing to ongoing research projects. The appointment will be made on a contract basis in the first instance, with the possibility of extension subject to satisfactory performance and funding availability. Purpose of the post The Research Assistant/Associate will work closely with the Principal Investigator and other members of the research team to ensure the smooth and efficient operation of the laboratory. The successful candidate will be responsible for general laboratory management, including procurement, inventory management, equipment maintenance, laboratory safety and administrative coordination. Depending on experience and research needs, the candidate will also have opportunities to support and participate in ongoing research projects. Main duties and responsibilities The Research Assistant/Associate will be accountable to the Principal Investigator and will be expected to: Oversee the day-to-day management and general operation of the laboratory Manage procurement of laboratory consumables, reagents and equipment, including quotations, ordering, deliveries and relevant documentation Maintain laboratory inventories and ensure adequate stocks of commonly used reagents, consumables and supplies Coordinate the maintenance, servicing, calibration and repair of laboratory equipment, including liaison with vendors and relevant university units Maintain laboratory documentation and support compliance with institutional laboratory safety, biosafety and administrative requirements, including laboratory access and onboarding of new staff and students. Qualifications The applicant should: (a) Have a Bachelor's degree or Master's degree in Biochemistry, Biomedical Sciences, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology or a related discipline (b) Have prior laboratory research experience experience in laboratory management, procurement, equipment maintenance or research administration would be advantageous (c) Be highly organised, responsible and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities (d) Be able to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a research team (e) Have good interpersonal and communication skills and be comfortable coordinating with researchers, administrative staff, vendors and service providers (f) Be proficient in common computer applications, including Microsoft Office applications such as Word, Excel and PowerPoint Candidates who are proactive, dependable and interested in contributing to both the scientific and operational aspects of an academic research laboratory are particularly encouraged to apply. Formal application: Please submit your application through the NUS Career Portal, indicating your current and expected salary, together with a detailed CV including personal particulars, academic and employment history, and the full contact details of three (3) referees. Willing to work shifts, weekends and public holidays as scheduled. Working Hours 5-day work week 44 working hours per week Shift hours will be scheduled according to operational requirements.
